descriptor: Nine-store Google Ads program and location reporting
status: Full-month Google delivery verified; click-to-directions remains a separate site reporting KPI
signal: The Replenish account generated 705 clicks from 38,690 impressions on $684.74 in August spend. Average cost per click was $0.97 across the store program.
goal: Give Mia one clear Replenish-only monthly view, preserve location-level detail, and add the site-based click-to-directions KPI before final client presentation.

benchmark.detail: August Google CPC than the 2026 Restaurants & Food search benchmark of $2.05.

work: Kept Replenish and 7-Eleven reporting completely separate from Fresh Blends.
Delivered two weekly reporting packets and maintained the location-level campaign structure.
Reconciled billing, account access, and campaign-readiness follow-ups during the month.
Prepared the monthly top-line KPI handoff and reserved click-to-directions for the existing site reporting layer.
analysis: Replenish delivered the largest click volume in the current Google portfolio at less than one dollar per click. The strongest campaign-level click-through rates were Carmel Mountain at 2.81% and Torrey Del Mar at 2.37%.
The client view remains intentionally brand-specific. Fresh Blends is not running in this report, and the monthly presentation should contain one Replenish PowerPoint only.
